name: multicore
description: MULTI-CORE + INTERNET: the shipped lean desktop boots and works on one core AND on two (qemu -smp 2); the BKL storms pass on the proof kernel; the full self-test suite runs on two cores; real DNS/HTTP/verified-HTTPS work on both

build.name: isos
build.why: builds mc-single.iso (default kernel), mc-smp.iso (MULTICORE=1) and mc-smp-storm.iso (MULTICORE=1 + FULL self-test storm)

assertions.stage: A single core (the T410-safe fallback)
assertions.why: the lean desktop boots and the compositor reports healthy to PID 1

assertions.stage: A single core (the T410-safe fallback)
assertions.pattern: LIVENET: PASS dns=1 http=1 https=1 trusted=1
assertions.why: real DNS + HTTP + certificate-verified HTTPS from inside the guest

assertions.stage: A single core (the T410-safe fallback)
assertions.why: at least 7 of the 8 real HTTPS sites connected AND verified through the embedded CA roots (a site that cannot connect is not a trust verdict)

assertions.stage: A single core (the T410-safe fallback)
assertions.why: all 8 connected; fewer = a transient external connect error (one such miss, letsencrypt.org ERR 3, was seen in 1 of ~24 boots; two immediate re-boots were 8/8)

assertions.stage: A single core (the T410-safe fallback)
assertions.why: the security property: no real site was ever reached WITHOUT its certificate chain verifying

assertions.stage: A single core (the T410-safe fallback)
assertions.why: the security property itself: NO broken certificate (expired / self-signed / wrong host / untrusted root) was ever trusted

assertions.stage: A single core (the T410-safe fallback)
assertions.why: at least 3 of the 4 broken-certificate probes were positively refused (a probe that cannot connect is not a verdict; see the warning below)

assertions.stage: A single core (the T410-safe fallback)
assertions.why: all 4 probes reached badssl.com and were refused; fewer means a probe could not connect (live-internet flake), not a trust failure

assertions.stage: A single core (the T410-safe fallback)
assertions.why: no kernel fault

assertions.stage: A single core (the T410-safe fallback)
assertions.name: final
assertions.why: the desktop actually painted
